correctness.rationale: Any nonzero cubic with a smooth F9 point admits a projectivity mapping the point and tangent incident flag to ([0:1:0],Z=0); smoothness forces nonzero Y²Z coefficient, scaling to one, while Y³ and XY² vanish. The seven remaining cubic coefficients each range independently over F9, giving an EXHAUSTIVE 9^7=4,782,969 coefficient finite proof after this normal form, including all singular/reducible cubics with any rational smooth point; curves with none cover zero. Read and checked supplied C++ field arithmetic and incidence bitsets. In addition, an independently implemented C++ F9 field, all 91 projective points/line incidence, derivative tests, and full seven-loop enumeration reproduced MAX_COVER=85, FULL_COVERAGE=0 and witness (0,1,0,0,0,0,1). The separate source Python program proves the smooth witness has 16 tangent lines, six uncovered points, claimed histogram; the classical Hermitian q9 quartic fills the plane. Lines, smooth conics (55 tangent-union points), and degenerate conics do not fill. The arithmetic evidence is a genuine exhaustive finite F9 certificate, not sampling, contingent on the exact projective normalization and field implementation.
residual_risks: No claim for fields other than F9 or classification of all maximizing cubic projective orbits.
